critical_path_rationale: T3.3 (368 bare-ID disambiguations, L-sized) is the single largest task. T2b.2 sequences after T2c.1 + T2d.4 per ADR-0053 algorithm. Phase 4 sequences after Phase 3 per Q-CC-6 (validator's first repo-wide run must be clean). T5.3 wires the packager surface (M-sized); T6.7 is the 3-surface negative-path harness (M-sized).

phases.phase_name: Validator wiring (3 surfaces) + skill audit + remediation

candidate_parallel_clusters.rationale: Both depend only on T0.1; no shared writers. T0.2 reads codebase-analysis.json, T0.3 writes new migration-log.md scaffold.
Each task edits a different operator file independently; no shared writers. T1.5 is convergence check and depends on all four.

Each touches different ADR ID ranges and different feature folders / different archive sub-procedures. T2d.2 and T2d.3 can also parallelize with T2d.1 (different ID ranges within adrs-migrated/). T2d.4 sequences last in Phase 2d (removes empty directory). T2b.2 (renumber) sequences last in all of Phase 2 per ADR-0053.
Different ID ranges within adrs-migrated/ (T2d.1: 0001-0006,0008-0010; T2d.2: 0011-0017; T2d.3: 0018). T2d.4 sequences last.

After T3.1 produces the inventory, T3.2 (32 path-form edits) and T3.3 (368 bare-ID disambiguation) can run concurrently — different reference types, no shared writers (T3.2 edits .md files at IN-008 paths; T3.3 edits .md files at inventory paths).

T5.1/T5.2/T5.3 (3-surface wiring) are independent file edits. T5.4/T5.5/T5.6 (skill audit) are independent file edits. All 6 parallelizable. Internal serialization: T5.3 depends on T1.1 (placeholder anchor); T5.6 depends on T1.3 + T5.2 (cross-references).

Independent verifications: T6.1 (reviewer gate), T6.3 (latency timing), T6.5 (rmdir cleanup), T6.8 (skill-audit completeness), T6.10 (NFR-7/8 audit). T6.2/T6.4/T6.6/T6.7/T6.9 form a second parallel cluster with light intra-dependencies.
T6.2 (pipeline-run probe), T6.4 (validator scan), T6.7 (negative-path harness), T6.9 (atomicity audit) — all parallelizable; T6.6 has minor sequencing on T6.4+T6.5.
Independent communications to different feature folders; no shared writers.

open_items_for_orchestrator: T3.3 is estimated L (could exceed if many bare-ID occurrences require AskUserQuestion escalation per AC-FR-9-b.1). The Plan's largest single task; consider sub-batching by source folder for tractability (4 batches: issue-capture-mechanism-r1 source files; canonical adrs/ADR-0044+0045 source files; cross-feature Blueprint prose; orchestrator/agent/skill prose). Per Plan §Estimation Methodology, this is the only L; not flagged XL but watch for execution-time scope creep.
T2d.2 is L (7 archive-wins cases × 5 sub-steps each); could parallelize internally across the 7 IDs if execution agent supports it.

Setup tasks (T0.1, T0.2, T0.3), cleanup task (T6.5), and communication tasks (TR.1, TR.2) have `satisfies_ac: ['N/A — setup'|'N/A — cleanup'|'N/A — communication']` per Plan §Orphan-task check. These are not mapped to PRD ACs by design; their verified_by_test arrays are empty (no AT directly tests setup/cleanup/communication tasks).

Inherited AC dispositions: AC-FR-6-a, AC-FR-6-b, AC-FR-7-a, AC-FR-10-f, AC-CC-6, AC-NFR-1-b, AC-NFR-3-a, AC-NFR-6-b are Blueprint-composition-resolved or design-precondition-met; per Plan §Acceptance Test Cross-Reference, no separate Plan task is required for these (each has explicit Plan re-verification or no-Plan-task rationale).

ADR cross-link: tasks T2b.2 (renumber sequencing), T5.1/T5.2/T5.3 (three-surface enforcement), T5.3 (Bash narrow grant), T2d.1-T2d.4 (archive-wins consolidation policy) bind to ADRs 0053/0054/0055 respectively. Execution agents should consult those ADRs during task implementation.
